title: A macro-level agent can be a real cause

statements.text: A whole agent, at the macro level where its causal power peaks, can be a real cause of what it does, not only its micro parts.

sources.quote: what exists absolutely, in physical terms, are intrinsic entities, and only what exists can cause.
Because only what truly exists (intrinsically, for itself) can truly cause, we, rather than our neurons, cause our willed actions and are responsible for their consequences [18].

sources.locator: Discussion, Causal Exclusion and Its Implications
sources.quote: From the perspective of a system, emergence (CE > 0) implies causal “self-definition” at the optimal macro level

sources.locator: Discussion, Causal Exclusion and Its Implications
sources.quote: to avoid double-counting causes, optimal macro causation must exclude micro causation
